action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Tarak takes the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, or {@action Hide} action.

Before coming to Dragon's Rest, Tarak was a criminal, but he has since devoted himself to the study of herbs and medicine. He is usually unarmed, but he keeps several daggers hidden in his cell (in area A1 of Dragon's Rest).
